title: Completed-coefficient open extension preserves flat-term K-flat models
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], an open immersion j:U→X and an unbounded K-flat complex P of modules over the actual completed coefficient sheaf A_U, assume tensoring with every term of P is exact. Then the termwise sheafified open extension cbcOpenShriek(d,j)(P), with its normalized completed coefficient slice transport, is K-flat over A_X. The module sheaves, tensor complex and K-flat predicate are those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and [def-pc-kflat-complex]. No quasi-compactness, boundedness or invertibility of a general completed pullback coefficient map is required.

source.place: K-flat preservation under extension by zero in the finite-exchange argument; Stacks Tags 00XZ, 0E8I, 06YN, 0G7E.

proof.text: Use the concrete equivalence from the ambient pro-etale slice to the open pro-etale site. The completed slice coefficient map, fixed by its finite projections, is invertible. Reindexing module sheaves and restricting scalars by this map presents algebraic inverse image: the underlying set sheaves are literal reindexings, and ring and module operation compatibility follows from the ring-map inverse identities.

Apply ringed-topos pullback preservation of K-flat complexes with flat terms to this algebraic inverse image followed by scalar extension along the identity ring map. The scalar-extension ring-isomorphism comparison identifies that composite with the reindexing functor itself. Transport K-flatness and flat terms along this natural isomorphism.

The original sheafified open extension is the composite of this module-to-slice transport and the existing ringed slice extension. Apply the ringed slice K-flat-preservation theorem to its image representative.

theorem cbcOpenShriek_kFlat_of_flatTerms
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : IsOpenImmersion j)
    (P : CochainComplex (pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U d)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := pbcAdicCompletion U d) P)
    (hflat : ∀ q : ℤ, exactFunctor _ _
      (@MonoidalCategory.tensorRight _ _
        (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (pbcAdicCompletion U d)) (P.X q))) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := pbcAdicCompletion X d)
      (((cbcOpenShriek d j hj).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
